behavior: Automatically match companies in the news title and body by security names and explicit security codes. Render all matching company charts below the article without stock search or company selection.
data: Existing news and local market data. Display-time matches do not rewrite stored news or its screening/evidence associations.

frontend_related.command: npm test -- src/pages/NewsPage.test.tsx src/pages/LibraryReading.test.tsx src/pages/LibraryWorkflow.test.tsx src/pages/TechnicalBrowser.test.tsx src/pages/PatternMatches.test.tsx
frontend_related.note: The unchanged TechnicalBrowser pointer test failed on the first run during concurrent build and passed on the repeated suite without code changes.

checks: Unlinked old news about 大华股份 automatically displays 002236.SZ candles
News mentioning 浙大网新 and 万里扬 directly displays both 600797.SH and 002434.SZ candles
Both charts remain visible at 240px height on narrow screens
Names embedded in longer phrases and generic robot-industry references are excluded by resolver tests
Title/body company matches are deduplicated; catalog updates apply without restarting
